'''Jalgpalliklubi Narva Trans''', commonly known as '''Narva Trans''' or simply '''Trans''', is an [[Estonia]]n professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Narva]] that competes in the [[Meistriliiga]], the top flight of [[Estonian football league system|Estonian football]]. Although the club's traditional home ground is [[Narva Kreenholm Stadium|Kreenholm Stadium]], they currently play their home matches at [[Narva Kalev-Fama Stadium|Kalev-Fama Stadium]].

The club was founded as Avtomobilist in 1979, changed their name to Autobaas in 1989 and Narva Trans in 1992. Narva Trans were one of the founding members of the Meistriliiga and are one of two clubs which have never been relegated from the Estonian top division since its inception in 1992, along with [[FC Flora|Flora]]. Narva Trans have won three [[Estonian Cup]]s and two [[Estonian Supercup]]s."}}
